verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source (Apache-2.0) client-side 3D rendering and game engine library distributed via npm, so an AI-training data opt-out, which is a data-handling control for hosted services, is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product collecting user data for model training or offering any related control, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
